Bug_Title: Classes should not be compared by name
Bug_Explanation: The code incorrectly compares class names as strings to determine the object type, which is unsafe because class names are not unique across different packages. This can lead to incorrect logic execution, for instance, treating objects from different packages as the same if they share a class name.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method, which executes the faulty logic in hasSellByDate(Object item). This method uses getClass().getSimpleName() to compare class names, causing Pear objects from different packages to be misclassified.
